cards.card_text: The Israelites groan and cry out under their burden of slavery.
cards.verse_text: The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
cards.snippet: The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.

cards.card_text: Then Moses passes on God's words, and God opens with who He is: "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery." Friend, when somebody pulls you out of the dark, you LISTEN to whatever they say next.
cards.verse_text: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
cards.snippet: …you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

cards.card_text: Don't forget the LORD who brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
cards.verse_text: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
cards.snippet: …you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

cards.card_text: That's why He brought them out with a mighty hand and redeemed them from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
cards.verse_text: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
cards.snippet: …out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

cards.card_text: True or false: Moses reminds Israel that the LORD brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
cards.verse_text: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
cards.snippet: …you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

cards.card_text: True or false: Moses describes the LORD the prophet rebels against as the One who brought Israel out of Egypt and redeemed them from the house of slavery.
cards.verse_text: Such a prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he has advocated rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery; he has tried to turn you from the way in which the LORD your God has commanded you to walk.

cards.card_text: He brought them up out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and He drove out their oppressors and gave them their land.
cards.verse_text: He sent them a prophet, who told them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I brought you up out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
cards.snippet: …I brought you up out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

cards.card_text: Solomon doesn't consign a single Israelite to slavery.
cards.verse_text: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slavery, because they were his men of war, his servants, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.
cards.snippet: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slavery, because they were his men of war, his servants, his officers, his…

cards.card_text: They say their children are just like their countrymen's children, yet they are subjecting their own sons and daughters to slavery.
cards.verse_text: We and our children are just like our countrymen and their children, yet we are subjecting our sons and daughters to slavery.
cards.snippet: …and their children, yet we are subjecting our sons and daughters to slavery.

cards.card_text: Was he born into slavery?
cards.verse_text: Was he born into slavery?
cards.snippet: Was he born into slavery?

cards.card_text: The LORD reminds them of the covenant He made with their forefathers when He brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
cards.verse_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying:
cards.snippet: …them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying:

cards.card_text: Judah, Jerusalem's kingdom, has gone into exile, under affliction and harsh slavery.
cards.verse_text: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place to rest.
cards.snippet: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place to rest.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD reminds them He brought them up from the land of Egypt and redeemed them from the house of slavery.
cards.verse_text: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery.
cards.snippet: …from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery.

cards.card_text: Paul tells the believers in Rome to offer the parts of their body in slavery to righteousness now.
cards.verse_text: Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.
cards.snippet: Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery…

cards.card_text: Paul tells his readers they did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns them to fear.
cards.verse_text: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption to sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba!
cards.snippet: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption…

cards.card_text: Paul says one of the two covenants bears children into slavery.
cards.verse_text: One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
cards.snippet: One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.

cards.card_text: Paul says the covenant from Mount Sinai, the one that bears children into slavery, is ___.
cards.verse_text: One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
cards.snippet: One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.

cards.card_text: She is in slavery with her children She was buried outside its walls She once lived inside its gates
cards.verse_text: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
cards.snippet: …in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul warns the Galatians not to be weighed down once more by a yoke of slavery.
cards.verse_text: Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
cards.snippet: …then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.

cards.card_text: Paul turns to all who are under the yoke of slavery, and how they should regard their masters.
cards.verse_text: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.

cards.card_text: Sharing in human flesh and blood, Jesus would also free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of ___.
cards.verse_text: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
cards.snippet: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
